extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

Hammer unions of different figure numbers must never be joined. The male (thread) half of a 2" Figure 602 or Figure 1002 union will make up into the wing nut of a 2" Figure 1502, so a mismatched joint can look made up and then separate under pressure; IADC records a fatality from a 602-to-1502 mismatch and recommends teaching the differences between union types, go/no-go ring gauges, colour coding and segregated storage.
extraFacts.source: IADC Safety Alerts 06-01 'Mismatched Hammer Union Results in a Fatality' and 03-16 'Mismatched Hammer Unions Still Being Found' (iadc.org/safety-alerts)

faqs.q: What is an API 6A double block and bleed ball valve used for?
faqs.a: An API 6A double block and bleed ball valve is two isolation valves and a bleed in one compact body, for wellhead and manifold isolation where a single valve is not enough. Each ball operates on its own, so if one leaks the other still holds and downstream maintenance can proceed safely.

faqs.q: What sizes and pressures does the API 6A double block and bleed ball valve cover?
faqs.a: The published range is 1-13/16" to 11" bore and 2,000 to 10,000 psi working pressure, with API 6A flanged or studded ends. Each unit is built to order, so send the bore, pressure and end connections on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What seat configurations does the double block and bleed ball valve have?
faqs.a: The valve has DIB-2 or DBB seat configurations. DBB seats each seal against pressure from one side and relieve cavity pressure, while DIB-2 has one bidirectional seat, so the cavity is isolated in both directions. Your specification will name one.

faqs.q: What leakage and fire-safe rating does the double block and bleed ball valve have?
faqs.a: It is rated ISO 5208 rate A (zero leakage), with a hardened, coated ball and seats, and fire-safe design to API 6FA. Hydrostatic body and seat tests follow API 6A at the PSL ordered, with gas tests at PSL 3G and 4.

faqs.q: What material classes does the API 6A double block and bleed ball valve offer?
faqs.a: The listing gives API 6A material classes AA to HH, with DD to HH for sour service, temperature classes L to X, and PSL 1, 2, 3/3G with PR1 or PR2. State the H2S content and temperature on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Is the double block and bleed ball valve made to API 6A?
faqs.a: Yes. It is built to API 6A and API 6FA, and supplied as an API-certified, API-monogrammed valve from an API-licensed manufacturer, with the API certificate and monogram documentation supplied with the order. CE-PED is also listed.

faqs.q: What documents come with an API 6A double block and bleed ball valve?
faqs.a: You receive API 6A documentation for the PSL ordered: material certificates, heat-treatment and NDE records, the hydrostatic test record (and gas test at PSL 3G and 4), and the dimensional report. Third-party witness is confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: How is the double block and bleed ball valve operated?
faqs.a: Each ball has its own handwheel or gear operator, and an actuator is available on request. Blow-out proof stems and seat self-relief of cavity over-pressure are part of the design.

faqs.q: Where is the API 6A double block and bleed ball valve used?
faqs.a: It is used for wellhead and manifold isolation where double isolation is required for safe maintenance. See [ball valves](/c/oilfield-ball-valves) and [gate valves](/c/oilfield-gate-valves).

faqs.q: How does the double block and bleed ball valve differ from a single trunnion ball valve?
faqs.a: It has two balls in one body with a bleed, while the [API 6A trunnion ball valve](/p/api-6a-trunnion-ball-valve) is a single-ball valve with lower torque. Choose double block and bleed where one valve cannot give the isolation you need.

faqs.q: What should I send for a double block and bleed ball valve quotation?
faqs.a: Send the nominal bore and working pressure, the end connections, the material and temperature class, PSL and PR level, the DIB-2 or DBB seat choice and the operator. Give H2S content for sour wells.

faqs.q: What is an API 6A floating ball valve used for?
faqs.a: An API 6A floating ball valve is a small, light quarter-turn valve for wellhead instrument, bleed, sample and small-bore lines. It is smaller and lighter than a gate or globe valve of the same rating, opens and closes with a quarter turn, and locks in either position.

faqs.q: What sizes and pressures does the API 6A floating ball valve cover?
faqs.a: The published range is 1-13/16" to 4-1/16" bore and 2,000 to 10,000 psi working pressure, with threaded or welded ends. Each unit is built to order, so send the bore, pressure and end connections on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Full port or reduced port for the API 6A floating ball valve?
faqs.a: Reduced port is standard and lighter; choose full port where the line must be rodded or pigged, or pressure drop matters. The listing offers full or reduced port.

faqs.q: What does the API 6A floating ball valve have for locking and safety?
faqs.a: It has lock holes at full open and full closed, so a padlock through the handle stops the valve being moved by mistake, which matters on bleed and isolation points. It also has an anti-static device and a blow-out proof stem.

faqs.q: What material classes does the API 6A floating ball valve offer?
faqs.a: The listing gives API 6A material classes AA to HH, with DD to HH for sour service, temperature classes L to X, and PSL 1 to 3 with PR1. State the H2S content and temperature on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Is the Indus floating ball valve made to API 6A?
faqs.a: Yes. It is built to API 6A and supplied as an API-certified, API-monogrammed valve from an API-licensed manufacturer, with the API certificate and monogram documentation supplied with the order.

faqs.q: What documents come with an API 6A floating ball valve?
faqs.a: You receive API 6A documentation for the PSL ordered: material certificates, heat-treatment and NDE records, the hydrostatic test record (and gas test at PSL 3G and 4), and the dimensional report. Third-party witness is confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: What end connections can the API 6A floating ball valve have?
faqs.a: The listing gives threaded or welded ends, lever operation and a compact body to suit the line. Send the thread type or weld preparation on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Where is the API 6A floating ball valve used?
faqs.a: It is used on instrument, bleed, sample and small-bore wellhead lines, where a compact lever-operated valve that locks open or closed is wanted. See [instrumentation valves](/c/oilfield-instrumentation-valves) and [ball valves](/c/oilfield-ball-valves).

faqs.q: How does the API 6A floating ball valve differ from the trunnion ball valve?
faqs.a: The floating valve is compact and lever operated to 4-1/16", while the [API 6A trunnion ball valve](/p/api-6a-trunnion-ball-valve) holds the ball on trunnions so torque stays low at higher pressures to 15,000 psi. Choose floating for small-bore lines.

faqs.q: What should I send for a floating ball valve quotation?
faqs.a: Send the nominal bore and working pressure, the end connections (threaded or welded), the port type, the material and temperature class, PSL, and the H2S content. We review the data sheet before quoting.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the API 6A floating ball valve?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the API 6A floating ball valve as ex-stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Each unit is built to order, so send the bore, pressure and ends through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is an API 6A trunnion ball valve used for?
faqs.a: An API 6A trunnion ball valve is quarter-turn isolation on wellheads, manifolds and flowlines, with the ball held on trunnions so torque stays low at pressure. It comes in two-piece, three-piece and top-entry designs for 2,000 to 15,000 psi.

faqs.q: What sizes and pressures does the API 6A trunnion ball valve cover?
faqs.a: Sizes start from 1-13/16" and are confirmed per order, with working pressure from 2,000 to 15,000 psi and API 6A flanged or studded ends. Send the bore and working pressure on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Soft or metal seats for an API 6A trunnion ball valve?
faqs.a: Soft seats seal bubble-tight on clean fluids and are fire-safe, backed by metal seats that seal if the soft seat burns out. Metal seats, hard-faced with nickel alloy or HVOF coating, handle sand, scale and high temperature.

faqs.q: What fugitive emissions and fire-safe features does the trunnion ball valve have?
faqs.a: It has an ISO 15848 stem seal, dual stem O-rings, a stepped, blow-out proof stem, spring-loaded seats and cavity relief, and a fire-safe design. Hydrostatic body and seat tests follow API 6A at the PSL ordered.

faqs.q: What material classes does the API 6A trunnion ball valve offer?
faqs.a: The listing gives API 6A material classes AA to HH, with DD to HH for sour service, temperature classes L to X, and PSL 1 to 4 with PR1 or PR2F. State the H2S content and temperature on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Is the Indus trunnion ball valve made to API 6A?
faqs.a: Yes. It is built to API 6A, with CE-PED and ISO 15848 listed, and supplied as an API-certified, API-monogrammed valve from an API-licensed manufacturer, with the API certificate and monogram documentation supplied with the order.

faqs.q: What documents come with an API 6A trunnion ball valve?
faqs.a: You receive API 6A documentation for the PSL ordered: material certificates, heat-treatment and NDE records, the hydrostatic test record (and gas test at PSL 3G and 4), and the dimensional report. Third-party witness is confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: How is the API 6A trunnion ball valve operated?
faqs.a: It can be operated by lever, gear operator, or pneumatic or hydraulic actuator. See [valve actuators](/c/valve-actuators) and [ball valves](/c/oilfield-ball-valves) for the actuator options.

faqs.q: Where is the API 6A trunnion ball valve used?
faqs.a: It is used on wellheads, manifolds and flowlines for isolation. The two-piece, three-piece and top-entry designs suit different line access and maintenance needs.

faqs.q: How does the API 6A trunnion ball valve differ from the 3-1/8 in 5M valve?
faqs.a: The configurable API 6A trunnion valve is built to your size and pressure from 2,000 to 15,000 psi, while the [3-1/8 in 5M flanged trunnion valve](/p/trunnion-ball-valve-3-1-8-in-5m-flanged-5-000-psi-sour-service) is a fixed 5,000 psi sour-service unit with a stated lead time.

faqs.q: What should I send for a trunnion ball valve quotation?
faqs.a: Send the nominal bore and working pressure, the end connections, the material and temperature class, PSL and PR level, the seat type and the operator. Give H2S content for sour wells.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the API 6A trunnion ball valve?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the API 6A trunnion ball valve as ex-stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Each unit is built to order, so send the bore, pressure and design through [our contact page](/contact).
